messages: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.

#p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to go say hello to #b#p411##k, the hidden leader of the city. I'm a bit scared to say hello to #p411# for the first time.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I was able to say hello to #p411#, the hidden leader of #m10003000#, for the first time. I felt completely overwhelmed by his presence.
name: First Greeting with Dark Lord
